# Automated Treasury Operation - Batch Job 56048B
## Summary

Execute automated treasury batch job for periodic approval renewals, reward distribution funding, and operational gas allocation. This batch follows the automated treasury operations framework established in HIP-12. Job ID: ATO-56048B

## Batch Contents

1. Approve StakingManager for 50,000 KITE (batch staking)
2. Transfer 500 KITE to RewardDistributor (batch distribution)
3. Approve RewardDistributor for 50,000 KITE (batch budget)
4. Transfer 100 OP to Admin Safe (batch gas)
5. Enable governance delegation
6. Approve Admin Safe for 10,000 KITE (batch contingency)

FOR: execute batch job. AGAINST: cancel job. ABSTAIN: no preference.
